title: Curio Design Recalls Modular Lights and Bases Due to Shock and Fire Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The modular lamp pieces can crack during assembly and the lamp bases have faulty wires, posing a shock and fire hazard. Units: About 1,500.

title: Toshiba Expands Recall of Laptop Computer Battery Packs Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The lithium-ion battery packs can overheat, posing burn and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 83,000 (91,000 units were previously recalled on March 30, 2016). In addition, 10,000 were sold in Canada and 5,000 in Mexico..

title: Walt Disney Parks and Resorts Recalls Minnie and Mickey Mouse Infant Hoodie Sweatshirts Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The snaps on the hoodies can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 15,000.

title: Trek Recalls Disc Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The front brake caliper can come into contact with a broken spoke, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 800 bicycles and 300 wheels (in addition, about 160 bicycles and 40 wheels were sold in Canada).

title: RH Baby & Child Recalls Mobiles Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The wheels on the mobile's hanging cars can detach and fall, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,000.

title: Boosted Recalls Electric Skateboards Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lithium ion battery pack can overheat and smoke, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,200 (in addition, about 100 units sold in Canada).

title: BRP Recalls Side-by-Side Off-Road Vehicles Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicles can unexpectedly roll away when in the "park" or "P" position, posing an injury hazard to users. Units: About 780.

title: Nantucket Distributing Recalls Pre-Lit Christmas Trees Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The fuse on the product can overheat and blow, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 600.

title: Yamaha Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Crash and Fire Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The turbocharger overboost can cause severe engine damage, posing crash and fire hazards to the user. Units: About 400.

title: Arctic Cat Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The fuel tank can crack and fuel can leak into the engine compartment, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 20,700.

title: Linon Home Décor Recalls Dressers Due to Tip-Over Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Wayfair.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled chests are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing a serious tip-over and entrapment hazard that can result in death or injuries to children. Units: About 200.

title: Textron Specialized Vehicles Recalls Bad Boy Off-Road Utility Vehicles Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death; One Death and One Injury Reported
summary: The vehicles lack seat belts, posing a risk of serious injury or death to the operator and passengers in the event of a vehicle accident. Units: About 1,100.

summary: Excessive lead paint levels on the yellow shank and black blade on the shovel, and the black paint on the garden tool set violates the federal lead paint standard. title: Michaels Recalls Rock Salt Lamps Due to Shock and Fire Hazards

summary: The base of the chairs can break during normal use, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 2 million (in addition, about 30,000 were sold in Canada and about 14,000 were sold in Mexico).

title: Teufelberger Recalls Rescue Ropes and Throwlines Due to Fall and Injury Hazards

summary: The beach chairs can collapse, posing fall and fingertip amputation hazards. Units: About 33,400.

summary: The batteries can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 101,000 (An additional 41,000 batteries were previously recalled in June 2016. About 3,000 were sold in Canada and 4,000 in Mexico.).
